#   UPDATE_ALLOWLIST_BASELINE=1 cargo test --test tracing_field_allowlist_lint

# operator-facing lines shipping empty; deleting a line here after either
# allowlisting the field or marking the call `// allowlist-exempt:` is how
# this file shrinks. It is not allowed to rot: an entry that no longer
# occurs fails the build too.
